title: Make migration import of the 2.3 GB Engram store finish in minutes, not more than an hour
outcome: Make migration import of the 2.3 GB Engram store finish in minutes, not more than an hour
acceptance: The slow phase of `migration import` on a copy of the live Engram store is identified from measured evidence: which step, which statement or index maintenance, and how its time grows with row count
`migration import` of that store's export completes on Central in a bounded time recorded on the item, with every row, id and link preserved and readiness reporting the new store ready
No row is skipped, batched away or dropped to gain speed, and an interrupted import leaves no partial target store
